integrity: Mathematical proof and explicitly reproducible exact-rational checks; publication identity, independent audit, and external certification are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the unweighted complete multipartite family with at least two size-two parts and one other part, and to the symmetric normalized-Laplacian Hamiltonian; no arbitrary-part or weighted extension is asserted. General strong-cospectrality and complete-multipartite spectral tools are established in earlier publications. The proof is analytic; the exact finite checker is supporting evidence, not an independent audit. A poorly indexed equivalent calculation cannot be ruled out.
title: Parity-complete normalized-Laplacian state transfer on multipartite twin-pair networks
